## 1. Package name and scientific purpose

Propose one FRUIT method for compact-source pointing, with one observation and
independent TolTEC array maps. Its result is an unfiltered normalized JINC map
with complete feedback lineage. The scientific purpose is to define exactly
how a declared feedback model changes source amplitude, centroid and morphology
under stated conditions, so a later authorized study can assess its utility.
This scope does not establish a source fit, accuracy or a beneficial method.

## 2. Scientific boundary

Begin with immutable original measured-parent ancestry, exact pre-removal
iteration input and state. Include model construction, causal selection,
acceptance and application; removal; the named residual-operation graph and
bypass; rejoin; subsequent admitted map construction; state transition,
completion and terminal selection. Distinguish the rejoined sample-domain
result from the downstream map product and its scientific identity.

End at a complete immutable iteration or selected-terminal JINC product and
its required FRUIT lineage/status records. The proposed route excludes
coaddition and post-map filtering. Calibration, coordinates, RTC, PTC cleaning,
JINC estimation, NOI uncertainty and downstream source/pointing inference
retain their own authorities.

## 3. Legitimate inputs

| Input role | Required identity and meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Measured parent and iteration input | One observation's exact original ancestry and authorized RTC/CAL/PTC relations; detector occurrence and stable sample association, sample/segment axes and time, unit/scale, beam/template and spectral/calibration convention, coordinate frame/grid, validity/support and additive reference/null-space state. Exact observation and numerical realization are unselected. |
| Model candidate, accepted model and applied model | Separate spaces and objects with target relation, origin, unit, frame/domain, grid, normalization, sign, reference/gauge, support, parentage and uncertainty. An internally constructed preceding-result model is proposed; acceptance means feedback use only. |
| Selection and projection inputs | Only exact values and consequential state available before their declared action. Every required companion has its own producer method, generation and quantity. No unseen outcome, true sky, oracle target or later terminal choice may select the applied model. |
| Residual and map operations | Exact numerical producer permissions and Pi/F/B signatures, additional transformations, state by operation, coordinate/coefficient/QC association, support and missing/non-finite policy. No numerical operator is supplied by the generic core. |
| Initial and future state | Proposed first request is unseeded. Complete causal state and future-control dependencies remain declared; no continuation claim is made without a complete query/equality contract. |
| Response and uncertainty | Exact perturbation/conditioning law, role, domain/codomain, operator/state generation and available or unavailable cause. External NOI references require their own method and admission. |

The original-parent rerun and complete-predecessor-model propositions are
pending owner choices for the first candidate, not generic FRUIT requirements.

## 4. Required outputs

Each requested completed iteration must satisfy the frozen universal bundle:
immutable parent/exact input, separate candidate/accepted/applied roles and
transformations, removal/residual-processing/rejoin identities and results,
path supports and information origins, state/iteration/application generations,
validity/causes, provenance, successor state and truthful response/uncertainty
statuses. Method-required roles add to this minimum; they cannot waive it.

A terminal output is an immutable selection record plus the selected completed
bundle and its underlying JINC role. Preserve candidate population, selection
rule/generation, stopped/completed/failed/resource facts, selected response and
uncertainty, continuation/terminality status and separately owned requested-use
records. Unavailable optional companions permit only claims allowed by both
core and exact method. Array absence creates no placeholder observation map.

## 5. Upstream and downstream responsibilities

PTC supplies its transformation and separate analysis/gridding coefficient/QC
identity; fixed-subspace internal application coordinates remain distinct.
AST supplies the exact same-processed-sample coordinate and target WCS.
JINC owns its signed estimator, grouping, numerical parameters, support,
normalization and admission. Its base bundle provides no response, covariance,
empirical-noise, significance or formal-weight product by implication.

Explicitly resolve the handoff from residual PTC output through FRUIT rejoin to
JINC. Ordinary PTC-to-JINC permission must not be presumed to admit any altered
descendant. Any required model companion and model-to-sample conversion needs
its own exact authority. FRUIT cannot manufacture missing producer permission.

NOI owns any ensemble/uncertainty method. FRUIT owns transformation and
conditioning. Pointing/source inference owns target-fit and fitness decisions;
VAL records/evaluates exact owner-authored policies and does not run recurrence.

## 6. Externally imposed conventions

Use the exact producer quantity, unit/scale, beam/template/spectral and
calibration lineage; a label such as mJy/beam is insufficient by itself.
No generic Stokes-I or true-sky interpretation follows. Preserve stable TolTEC
array identities, detector/sample association, timing and coordinate authority.
Bind each additive reference/gauge and unavailable mode independently for
removal and rejoin. Model/prior-supported modes are not recovered measurements.

The proposed grouping is observation-local, separately per array; PTC detector
grouping remains a separately approved upstream choice. No averaging across
observations, inverse projection, equal path support, unit model response or
linear full procedure is assumed.

## 7. Questions the contract must answer

Define all twenty-one frozen method classes. Resolve the exact target/model
relation; causal construction/selection/acceptance/application and their
transformations; original-parent input rule and complete-model update;
Pi/F/B and downstream operation graph; all operation-state categories; eight
supports and four information-origin classes; additive compatibility; learning
schedule; continuation and stochastic state; response/uncertainty targets;
finite resource/stopping/terminal rules; and completeness/failure/publication.

Use the seven frozen response roles without inventing a new family. For
RF-01/02 fix complete defining maps/state while evaluating their internal
application coordinates on the perturbed operand. Keep full state relearning,
fixed-extent recurrence, terminal selection, upstream physical response and
FRUIT-only parent-domain response separate. A mode count or fixed subspace
alone proves no linearity for the full procedure.

Retain law-relative targets, all applicable uncertainty roles and both
measured-parent/applied-model cross terms under full fixed-linear premises.
State model/selection/learning/support/terminal variation omitted by a
conditional product. A zero-law NOI perturbation action is not an affine
rejoined parent action or empirical ensemble centering.

## 8. Non-goals

No new generic FRUIT or PCA derivation; no alternate cleaner, benefit selector,
accelerated accumulation, coadd/filter route, external model seeding or
scientific continuation claim in the first requested method. No numerical
input population, operator value, threshold, cap, experiment, implementation
assessment, repair, replay, qualification, production or Unity operation is
approved. This scope does not extend the generic-core authorship exception.

## 11. Independence statement

This brief states a proposed scientific problem and boundary. It does not
prescribe Citlali source, defaults or numerical outcomes as the correct answer.
A future author may use only the exact approved brief, covered scientific
references and owner answers, in isolation from implementation and evidence.
Historical control remains mandatory for later empirical comparison, with
independent-pointing replication required before policy. Neither obligation
admits historical evidence into scientific derivation. No author is launched.
